svg.title: Backer placement opposite the rail
svg.desc: Original cross-section schematic not to scale. Y rail is under the gantry extrusion with titanium backer on top using the documented M3x8 flat-head screws. X has a front MGN12 rail and a rear backer using M3x6 flat-head screws. Confirm the actual rail geometry first; mounting a single-front-rail X backer on top is not the specified arrangement.
svg.metadata: Original custom-guide schematic, GPL-3.0; factual placement from tanaes/whopping_Voron_mods pinned README. Does not depict detailed manufactured geometry.

g.text: Original non-dimensional cross-section schematic • verify the actual rail arrangement
Ordered size, actual holes, thickness, nuts and all CNC/chain clearances still require measurement.
